objective: Verify the bounded Linux SocketCAN receive boundary from validated ingress through the host CAN adapter to a read-only external event projection, with truthful virtual and physical evidence labels.
decision_supported: Issue #229 acceptance for SocketCAN ingress, Wire V1 validation, bounded runtime handoff, virtual regression, and physical-HIL procedure.
acceptance: The adapter uses one standard AF_CAN/CAN_RAW SocketCAN descriptor with kernel filtering, bounded poll/recvmsg, explicit close, and no adapter-local worker or unbounded queue.
Classic CAN standard, extended, RTR, error, DLC, truncation, raw arbitration-ID flags, and kernel timestamp records are validated before Wire V1 decoding; malformed records are observable rejections.

Only complete Wire V1 inbound ACK, STOP_ACK, and telemetry frames reach the bounded runtime and immutable read-only external projection; duplicate, late, uncorrelated, fault, and invalid frames cannot claim completion.
Link-down, bus-off/error frames, transport backpressure, slow external consumers, shutdown, and recovery have bounded fail-closed behavior with observable diagnostics and drop counters.

External records contain source, interface, ingress sequence, DLC, timestamps and source, event type, payload/protocol fields, health, evidence reference, and rejection/exposure status without a socket or write handle.

The deterministic virtual ingress probe exercises a real SocketCAN vcan path when privileged prerequisites exist, validates the exact external record, emits PASS/FAIL/NOT_EXECUTED, and cleans up interfaces and sockets.

The physical HIL procedure identifies the isolated USB-CAN-FD prototype path, six control domains, raw capture hash, kernel/interface/clock/calibration references, and fail-closed PASS/FAIL/NOT_EXECUTED derivation.
No firmware, frozen interface/schema, robot-control, physical CAN, MCU, actuator, PREEMPT_RT, or hard-real-time implementation claim is made by this task.

evidence: Focused unit tests for frame layout, transport lifecycle, Wire V1 validation, runtime correlation, bounded projection and shutdown.
Machine-readable virtual SocketCAN ingress report with an explicit evidence scope and PASS/FAIL/NOT_EXECUTED result.
Task Packet changed-path validation, repository contract/scenario/context checks, strict documentation build and kernel module build output.

Physical HIL bring-up record containing interface, adapter, six-domain discovery, kernel/config, clock, calibration, raw capture hash and reviewer references; absent physical inputs remain NOT_EXECUTED.
stop_conditions: A change to Wire V1 identifiers, payload layout, public schema, firmware HAL, MCU behavior, robot control, or safety authority is required.
A second adapter-local lifecycle, worker, queue, callback registry, or unbounded retry/diagnostic path is required.
A physical CAN, USB-CAN-FD, MCU, actuator, PREEMPT_RT, electrical, or hard-real-time result cannot be reproduced with the recorded evidence and owner review.
The host lacks the privileges, kernel modules, interface, adapter, capture, or calibration input needed for a claimed PASS; record NOT_EXECUTED instead.
A write outside the allowed paths or a production debugfs/ioctl control API would be needed.
data_classification: hardware ingress metadata and test evidence; no credentials or device write handles
model_policy: No model output is admitted as a CAN frame, protocol decision, safety state, or physical evidence.
